method: Replace [CITY, COUNTRY], [ICONIC LANDMARK] and [FAMOUS FOR] with your destination, then use the exact source prompt. It asks for a cohesive miniature world with local architecture, transport, landscape and cultural details; the source examples show raised relief, visible puzzle seams and a destination label panel. In the Barcelona example, the main heading names the Sagrada Familia rather than the city; check the generated lettering for your chosen destination.

variants.label: Miniature puzzle-piece travel diorama
variants.promptText: Create a charming 3D puzzle-piece travel scene of [CITY, COUNTRY], designed as a single cohesive miniature world. Build the city from beautifully interlocking puzzle pieces, with [ICONIC LANDMARK] as the central focal point. Surround it with recognizable local architecture, streets, trees, transportation, landscape, and small cultural details. Make the puzzle pieces slightly raised with visible seams, rounded edges, layered depth, and soft realistic shadows. Use a sophisticated palette inspired by the city, subtle handcrafted textures, warm studio lighting, clean cream background, playful yet premium collectible-diorama aesthetic. Add elegant 3D lettering: “[CITY]” and underneath “[COUNTRY] • [FAMOUS FOR]”. Highly polished, cute, artistic, detailed, and instantly recognizable.

purpose: Create a miniature travel diorama that places a chosen city and landmark at the center of one cohesive puzzle-piece world.
summary: A city and its landmark become one collectible miniature world built from raised puzzle pieces with local architecture, transport, landscape and destination lettering.
title: Miniature puzzle-piece travel diorama
